                     deliver_before, max_attempts, dedupe_key, next_attempt_at)
                VALUES ($1, $2::text::coupon.notification_channel, $3, 'PENDING', $4, $5, $6,
                        $7, $8, $9, $10, $11, $12, $9)
                ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) WHERE dedupe_key IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
                RETURNING id
